text:
maria: Heads-up — auto-pages didn't fire for notify-bridge between ~07:12-07:20 UTC. Incident channel shows a bunch of 'suppressed' messages from the bot. Anyone triaging?

inc-bot: detected suppression anomaly for service=notify-bridge; event_count=8; reason=policy.suppressed_window_mismatch; sample_log:
```
[2026-03-17T07:14:12Z] webhook POST /notify -> 429 Too Many Requests
suppression_eval: true (window=02:00-03:00, parsed_tz=America/New_York, server_tz=UTC)
```

jon: :eyes: I was oncall; didn't receive the pages. Confirming manual alerts sent?

ana: I'm looking at pagerflow -> suppressor config. We pushed a schedule change last night and the cron expression got converted with local tz strings. It looks like the suppressor parsed "02:00" as local (America/Los_Angeles) while the scheduled shift is UTC. Repro local: `python -c "import dateutil; print(parse('02:00').tzinfo)"`

alice: I can patch prod suppressor to prefer explicit TZ parsing. Quick mitigation: clear suppressor cache + force-eval for last 15m. Rolling now (will restart notifier-worker on two pods, one at a time).

maria: Please also trigger manual pages for any customers that were mid-job between 07:10-07:20 UTC. We need to track customer impact. Affected customers so far: internal smoke tests, two enterprise customers running nightly syncs (acme-corp, datawave).

jon: Manual pages sent to rotation and to acme SRE. Acme confirmed they saw delayed job runs — they lost ~8 webhooks; investigating replay.

tim-oncall: I got manual page and took ownership. Monitoring logs; if suppression stays on after the patch I'll escalate to infra. ETA for patch finish ~4m.

inc-bot: action_log: suppressor_cache_cleared by alice@ops at 6312348292; notifier-worker-restart started -> pod/notifier-1 restarting

alice: restart complete on pod/notifier-1; rolling to pod/notifier-2 now. Patch includes explicit tz='UTC' in schedule parser. Diff snippet:
```
- schedule = parse_time(spec)
+ schedule = parse_time(spec, default_tz='UTC')
```

ana: Confirmed eval after restart: previously suppressed events now evaluated and re-emitted where severity>=P2. Replayed 6 webhook events to notify-bridge.

maria: Good. Logging incident INV-2026-105 for follow-up: root cause = scheduler TZ parsing change; mitigation = patch and cache clear; customer impact = delayed pages and missed webhooks for acme-corp & datawave; follow-ups: add unit tests for TZ parsing + add alert if suppressor suppresses > threshold without an oncall page.

tim-oncall: Monitoring steady. Will keep this thread updated if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
